create_VideoRecorder: create a VideoRecorder instance to record environment frames at a specified resolution and fps
init_VideoRecorder: init the VideoRecorder to enable or disable frame recording for a new episode
record_VideoRecorder: record a single frame from a gym environment using the VideoRecorder record method
save_VideoRecorder: save recorded frames to a video file using the VideoRecorder save method with imageio
create_VideoRecorder_with_background: create a VideoRecorder with a random video background source to replace green screen pixels
